local.description: Node-local ordinal, allocated by the owning registry.

NodeId.description:
A node in the (future) multi-host deployment. `LOCAL` is the only legal value in v4.0.

Rule: X7 (`00-overview.md`); it qualifies every id of TM-11, SC-6, SB-3 and MA-38.

TimeErrorCause.description: Why a radio burst reported a time error (RM-22).

oneOf.description: The target did not meet the required lead (RM-22).
A new timed block followed an unclosed burst (RM-22).

TimeErrorOutcome.description: What the Provider did about a late burst (RM-22).

oneOf.description: Reject a plan-time violation at runtime (RM-22).

The Provider handed the burst over in time by its own clock and the device
reported it late, so nothing was transmitted (RM-11, VE-3).

TimePoint.description:
An instant: integer ticks in a named clock domain. Never floating-point seconds.

There is deliberately no `PartialOrd`: two points of different domains cannot be
compared at all, and `a < b` silently answering `false` is the bug class this
model exists to prevent (decision T3).

Rule: TM-1, TM-6.

ticks.description: Tick count relative to the domain's origin; a sample index in a SampleClock (TM-10).

late_by_ns.description: How late the target was, in nanoseconds (RM-22).
